faqs: Do you cover Huntingdon, Godmanchester and Brampton?
Yes. Huntingdon is about 20 miles from our workshop, usually around 30 minutes via the A1(M) and A14, and we fit across Godmanchester, Brampton, Hartford and the Hemingfords with the same team.
Can you replace the developer kitchen in a new build?

Yes, it’s one of our most common jobs, including at Alconbury Weald. Planning the new kitchen around the existing plumbing and sockets usually keeps costs down, and we often add a utility or media wall at the same time.
Can a narrow galley kitchen be made to work better?

Usually, yes. Made-to-measure units, full-height storage and a better layout make a real difference. If moving services would give you a much better kitchen, we’ll explain the trade-off at the survey.
What does a fitted kitchen cost?
As a guide, straightforward fitted kitchens start from around £5,000, with larger kitchens and premium finishes costing more. You get an itemised quote after the free survey.
Can I see your kitchens and wardrobes in person?
Yes. Our showroom is at 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough PE1 2AZ, about 30 minutes from Huntingdon. Call 01733 686767 to arrange a time.
